key_moments.title: Hi I'm Natalie and I've just arrived at Qudos Bank Arena in Sydney Olympic Park.
When you first arrive, you'll line up in one of the ten lines leading into the arena.
You'll need your booking confirmation and your ID to get started.
While you're in line you'll also have to use the Service NSW check in app.
You'll need to sanitise and change your mask.
You're going to need your booking code or your QR code and you're going to scan in here.
Here you'll be asked all the normal questions.
And you'll be told you're receiving the Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine.
This is to make sure you're okay and don't have an allergic reaction...
You'll go through the same process for your second vaccination.
